lines.t: Terraria has sold over 70 million copies, and its final update has happened more than once.
Terraria is a 2D sandbox game. You dig, build, craft gear, and fight huge bosses.
Every world is randomly generated, and there's no set goal. You can play as a melee fighter, a ranger, a mage, or a summoner.
It was created by Andrew Spinks, who used to work on a Super Mario fan game.

sc.sub: worked on Super Mario Bros. X

lines.t: A tweet from Minecraft's creator, Notch, helped people discover it.
It sold 50,000 copies on day one.
Over 70 million copies have now been sold, making it one of the best selling games ever.
In 2012, the developer said there would be no more updates. A year later, he came back.
In 2020, Journey's End was announced as the final update.
Then came Labor of Love. Then 1.4.5, with Palworld and Dead Cells content.
lines.say: Then came Labor of Love. Then one point four point five, with Palworld and Dead Cells content.

lines.t: And this May, they confirmed even more. The final update just keeps not being final.
Every update has been free, and there are no microtransactions.
Its creator once said Minecraft isn't a game anymore, it's a genre.

sc.quote: MINECRAFT ISN'T A GAME ANYMORE, IT'S A GENRE.
